papers.title: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
papers.abstract_snippet: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments.
